bias.en: Bearish · back above the 10-day, under the October closes
bias.zh: 偏空 · 重回 10 日均线上方，受制于 10 月收盘价区间

read.en: ASML rose 2.8% on Oct 27 to $1,635.57, trading between $1,598.94 and $1,643.67. It is above the falling 5-day ($1,607.1) and 10-day ($1,626.2) and the rising 200-day ($1,591.8), and below the falling 30-day ($1,715.2) and 100-day ($1,745.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,729.11), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: 阿斯麦 10月27日上涨 2.8%，收于 $1,635.57，盘中区间 $1,598.94–1,643.67。股价位于下行的 5 日（$1,607.1）和 10 日均线（$1,626.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$1,591.8）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$1,715.2）和 100 日均线（$1,745.5）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$1,729.11），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The close cleared $1,606–1,614 and the 10-day, now support; the $1,643.7 high stalled in the $1,641–1,657 band of Oct 14–19 closes. Resistance is $1,641–1,657, then $1,687.8 (Oct 21 high) and $1,715 (30-day). Support is $1,607–1,626 (5 and 10-day), then $1,583–1,592 (200-day, Oct 26 low) and $1,550. A close above $1,657 would target $1,688–1,715; below $1,607, $1,590.
